summary: Async pipeline that submits book metadata to Bokbasen's national distribution registry via ONIX 3.0 XML over their metadata-import API. Covers OAuth2 token caching, HTTP stage/poll/cancel lifecycle, durable Oban-based state machine, and per-document export-status tracking.

intentions.title: Publish book metadata to Norwegian national distribution (Bokbasen)
intentions.evidence: publish_worker.ex drives a :pending→:staging→:staged→:polling→:accepted state machine; client.ex POSTs ONIX XML to /metadata/import/onix/v2 and polls for acceptance; the entire subsystem exists to get a publisher's book record into the Norwegian Bokbasen registry

intentions.title: Idempotent async publication with Oban snooze/retry
intentions.evidence: publish_worker.ex uses unique: [keys: [:document_id], period: 60] to deduplicate re-enqueues, {:snooze, secs} between stage and poll, and submission_id presence to skip re-staging on retry — no duplicate submissions even under crash/retry

intentions.title: Durable, observable per-document export status
intentions.evidence: status.ex maintains a normalized composite bp_export_status map on the document, with backwards-compat read across three historical storage shapes; write/2 broadcasts {:bokbasen_status_update, …} on PubSub so Studio LiveViews refresh in real time; ExternalSync.broadcast emits a plugin-agnostic topic too

intentions.title: Resilient HTTP client with typed error discrimination
intentions.evidence: client.ex maps 401/403→AuthError, 422→SchemaRejectionError, 429→RateLimitError, 5xx→retried HTTPError, transport failures→NetworkError; publish_worker.ex pattern-matches each struct to decide snooze vs cancel vs retry — no string parsing

intentions.title: Secure credential handling with redaction in logs
intentions.evidence: settings.ex resolves credentials env-first then encrypted DB row; errors.ex implements custom Inspect for all five error structs, scrubbing authorization headers and access_token/client_secret/client_id JSON keys before any inspect/Logger call

intentions.title: Multi-tenant scope isolation for async jobs
intentions.evidence: publish_worker.ex put_scope_args/2 and scope_opts_from_args/1 round-trip workspace_id/project_id through Oban string-keyed args so the worker re-reads the correct tenant's document even after a crash and re-execution

intentions.title: Rate-limit and retry budget enforcement
intentions.evidence: client.ex applies a configurable per-request floor sleep (BOKBASEN_RATE_LIMIT_MS), respects Retry-After on 429 up to a 5-second budget, auto-retries 5xx up to max_retries; publish_worker.ex enforces a separate @max_effective_attempts cap and snoozed backoff
